content.thinking:
I'm working out the structured output from a delivery note issued by Karton Nowak in Poznań: number WZ-261021-680, dated 21 October 2026, going to the Soony Distribution Center in Hamburg under order 4500318731. I'm now looking at the first line item, an art book with 13,500 pieces.

Next I'm checking the rest of the delivery note: the packaging count, the gross weight of 66 kg, and the carrier reference PO 53225. The note also asks for the pallets to be returned, and a handwritten signature from Meyer K. appears under the receipt line. A 66 kg gross weight for 13,500 hardcover books looks low, so I'm considering whether to flag that, though I'm not changing the recorded figure.

I'm deciding how to record the handwritten receiver signature, and whether it counts as a correction or just a note. I'm leaning toward listing it as a handwritten receiver signature rather than a correction. Then I'm weighing the status: the 66 kg gross weight looks too low for 13,500 books, and the pallet return request is worth flagging too, so I'm settling on a warning status with those two red flags and recording the delivered quantity as 13.

I'm settling on the date field for the delivery note's issue date, 21.10.2026, and using the shipped-date slot for it. The carrier reference PO 53225 goes in as an other-type reference, and the pallet note is a statement to record. No decision is needed for the "Odebrał" line.
